property_summary: A plain externally-owned account (no code) cannot pass the supportsToken check, so airDrop() from any codeless caller must revert and leave its tokenBalance at 0; the mutant replaces the check with require(true), so such a caller succeeds and gets 20 tokens, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Replace the supportsToken token check with a trivially true require so any caller (not just the Bank contract) can airdrop.
